πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’many (works)’
πολλῶν: πολύς — much, many; gen. pl., of persons: ’of many (men)’
πολύμηλον: πολύμηλος — rich in flocks (πολύς + μῆλον ’sheep, goat’); adj., masc. acc. sg.
πουλυβοτείρῃ: πολυβότειρα — much-nourishing, giving much pasture; fem. dat. sg., epic πουλυ- and -ῃ (= Attic πολυβοτείρᾳ), epithet of the earth
ποῖον: ποῖος — of what kind, what sort of; masc. acc. sg., interrogative: ’what sort of (word)?’
πρηνὴς: πρηνής — face down, headlong; masc. nom. sg.
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
προβλῆτι: πρόβλης — jutting out, projecting; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with σκοπέλῳ
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
πρώτας: πρῶτος — first, foremost; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with στήλας: ’the first (laid)’ · also fem. acc. pl. with the pronoun τάς: ’the first (ships)’
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πόντοιο: πόντος — sea; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress, revered; fem. nom. sg., title of a goddess or queen · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’lady’
πᾶσα: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. nom. sg., with χθών · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἔπαλξις: ’the whole (of it)’ · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with Ἴλιος: ’all (of Ilios)’
σαρπηδόνα: Σαρπηδών — Sarpedon, a Lycian leader; masc. acc. sg.
σαρπηδόνος: Σαρπηδών — Sarpedon, Lycian prince and ally of Troy; masc. gen. sg.
σαρπηδὼν: Σαρπηδών — Sarpedon, a Lycian leader; masc. nom. sg.
στέρνον: στέρνον — chest, breast; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect
στήλῃ: στήλη — upright slab, pillar, gravestone; fem. dat. sg.
στόμ: στόμα — mouth; neut. acc. sg., elided (στόμ’ = στόμα)
συνίτην: σύνειμι (εἶμι) — come together, meet; impf. 3 dual, unaugmented (= Attic συνῄτην): ’the two met’
σφι: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl. σφι: ’to/for them’ (= Attic αὐτοῖς)
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by; adv. (also + gen./dat.)
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
σῇσιν: σός — your, yours; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς), agreeing with φρεσί
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’ · also accented before the enclitic σφισιν (ἀπό τέ σφισιν ’and from them’) · also accented before the enclitic ποτ’ (ὅς τέ ποτ’), the epic particle of what holds generally, not translated · also accented before the enclitic μοι (ὅ τέ μοι), the epic particle of the relative clause, not translated
τέκμωρ: τέκμωρ — a fixed mark, sign, pledge; neut. nom. sg. (indecl.) · also goal, end, issue (τέκμωρ Ἰλίου ’the end of Ilios’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἵκετο: ’goal, end (of a journey)’
τανύηκες: τανύηκης — long-pointed (second element ἀκ- ’point’, sense not fully certain); neut. acc. sg., with ἄορ
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τείχεος: τεῖχος — wall; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -εος (= Attic τείχους)
τεύχεσιν: τεῦχος — armour, gear; neut. dat. pl., ν-movable
τεὸν: τεός (epic possessive = σός) — your, yours; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with φθόγγον: ’your’
τηλόθι: τηλόθι — far off, far away; epic adv. with suffix -θι, + gen.: ’far from’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’) · also masc. acc. pl. in the correlative τοὺς μέν … τοὺς δέ: ’some … others’
τοῖο: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic τοῦ); gen. of the person heard after ἀκούω: ’him’ · also temporal: ἐκ τοῖο ’from that time, after that’ · also masc. gen. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that (old man)’ · also plain possessive gen.: ’his’
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’with them’ · also masc. dat. pl., ’among them, to them’ (τοῖσιν … μετέφη ’spoke among them’) · also relative, masc. dat. pl.: ’against whom’ (τοῖσιν κότον ἔθεσθε ’against whom you conceived resentment’)
τοῦδ: ὅδε — this (one); demonstrative pron., neut. gen. sg., elided (τοῦδ’ = τοῦδε), with ἕνεκα: ’for this’
τροίῃ: Τροίη — Troy; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic Τροίᾳ)
τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τύμβῳ: τύμβος — burial mound, tomb; masc. dat. sg.
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’ · also dual nom. with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … ὄσσε ’his two eyes’)
υἱέες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἱέες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
φάλαγγας: φάλαγξ — line of battle, battle-line, phalanx; fem. acc. pl.
φέρειν: φέρω — carry, bear, bring; pres. inf.
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φίλος: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dear (to him)’ · also attributive, ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (Menelaus)’
φαεινῷ: φαεινός — shining, bright, radiant; masc./neut. dat. sg.
φράζεο: φράζομαι — take note, observe, consider; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic φράζου): ’mark, take note’
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φὼς: φώς — man; masc. nom. sg. (epic, φωτός in the gen.)
χαμᾶζε: χαμᾶζε — to the ground, down to earth; adv. (χαμαί + -δε)
χειρῶν: χείρ — hand; fem. gen. pl., dependent on a noun: μένος χειρῶν ’the might of hands’ · also fem. gen. pl., of separation after ἐκ: ’from the hands’ (ἐκ … χειρῶν ’out of the hands’) · also fem. gen. pl., object of ἅπτομαι (gen. of the part touched): χειρῶν ἁψάσθην ’took hold of his hands’ · also fem. gen. pl. of separation after ἀπό: ’from the hands’ (θρασειάων ἀπὸ χειρῶν ’from the bold hands’)
χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
χθονὶ: χθών — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
χύτο: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, passive sense (= Attic ἐχύθη): ’was poured, was shed’
ψυχή: ψυχή — soul, life-breath, the self that leaves at death; fem. nom. sg.
ἀΐξας: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’darting’
ἀγκυλομήτεω: ἀγκυλομήτης — of crooked cunning (exact sense uncertain); masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου), epithet of Cronus
ἀθανάτων: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; gen. pl., as a noun, partitive: ’of the immortals’ · also adj., gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’immortal’ (ἀθανάτων … θεῶν ’of the immortal gods’)
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλοισιν: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’to one another’
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀνέρος: ἀνήρ — man; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀνδρός)
ἀπέκοψε: ἀποκόπτω — cut off, sever; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’cut off’
ἀπίθησε: ἀπιθέω — disobey (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, negated by οὐδέ: ’did not disobey’
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’) · also with a noun in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ’from the string’)
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. sg.: ’another thing’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an unexpressed verb: ’else’ (οὐ … ἄλλο ’nothing else’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with an understood πῦρ: ’the other’
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’
ἄλοχόν: ἄλοχος — wife, spouse; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄντυγος: ἄντυξ — rim, rail of a chariot; fem. gen. sg., with ἐκ: ’from the rail’ · also the rim of a shield: fem. gen. sg., with ὑπέρ: ’above the rim’ (ὑπὲρ ἄντυγος)
ἄορ: ἄορ — sword (poetic, = ξίφος); neut. acc. sg.
ἄπο: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (νεῶν ἄπο ’from the ships’) · also adv. or preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb: ’off’ (ἄπο … νίζοντες ’washing off’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἆλτο: ἅλλομαι — leap, spring; aor. 3 sg. mid., athematic, epic (= Attic ἥλατο): ’sprang’
ἐγών: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., epic form with ν (ἐγών = ἐγώ)
ἐθέλεις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 2 sg.
ἐθέλῃσι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -σι (= Attic ἐθέλῃ), after αἴ κ’: ’if he wishes’ · also in a general relative clause after ἥν κ’: ’whichever he wishes’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλέησε: ἐλεέω — pity, have compassion on; aor. 3 sg. act., + acc.: ’pitied’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’) · also in ἐξ αὖτις, adverbial: ’again, once more’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’)
ἐπαινέομεν: ἐπαινέω — approve, agree to; pres. 1 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐπαινοῦμεν)
ἐπασσυτέρους: ἐπασσύτερος — one close upon another, in quick succession; adj., masc. acc. pl.
ἐπεσσύμενον: ἐπισεύομαι — rush upon; perf. part. (pres. force) masc. acc. sg.: ’rushing on’
ἐπιβαινέμεν: ἐπιβαίνω — go upon, get onto, board; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐπιβαίνειν), + gen.
ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν; Attic ἐπάν); conj. + subj.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐριβώλακι: ἐριβώλαξ — with rich soil, clod-rich; fem. dat. sg.
ἐρύμαντα: Ἔρυμας, -αντος — Erymas, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
ἐσθλῶν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; gen. pl., as a noun of persons: ’of the brave’
ἐστί: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg.; with a perf. part., periphrastic perfect: ’has been, is done’
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’) · also + gen., ’over, around’ (ἐφ’ ὁμίλου ’over the crowd’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐφ’ ἱπποπόλων Θρῃκῶν ’toward the horse-herding Thracians’)
ἐχίον: Ἐχίος — Echius, a Greek warrior; masc. acc. sg.
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
ἑτέρωθεν: ἑτέρωθεν — from the other side; adv. with suffix -θεν
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἔασον: ἐάω — allow, let be; aor. imper. 2 sg. (+ acc. and inf.): ’allow’
ἔβραχε: βράχω — crash, clang, roar; aor. 3 sg. act., strong aorist
ἔγχεϊ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
ἔειπες: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 2 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (ἔειπες = εἶπες)
ἔεργε: εἴργω (ἔργω) — shut in, enclose; impf. 3 sg., epic ἔεργε (= Attic εἶργε): ’enclosed’ · also keep off, hold apart, with ἀπό: ’kept up from’ (ἀπὸ χθονὸς ὑψόσ’ ἔεργε ’kept them high above the ground’)
ἔλυσεν: λύω — loosen, unstring; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’loosened’ · also ’set free, released’ (a captive, for ransom)
ἔμελλε: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to (+ inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’was about to’
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθά: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’)
ἔοργε: ῥέζω — do, work, perform; perf. 3 sg. act. ἔοργε (from ἔρδω): ’has done’
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπεσ: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔπεσ’ = ἔπεσε), in tmesis with ἐν: ’fell into’ · also aor. 3 sg., elided, with no preverb: ’fell’ (ἔπεσ’ … χαμαί ’fell to the ground’)
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί as a preverb in tmesis (ὦρσεν ἔπι = ἐπῶρσεν ’roused against’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, ’for’ (δώρῳ ἔπι μεγάλῳ ’for a great gift’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’at, against’ (Τυδεΐδῃ ἔπι … τόξα τιταίνετο ’drew his bow at Tydeides’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’by, along’ (ὁδῷ ἔπι ’by the road’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’at’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’at the hollow ships’, with ὀλέκονται)
ἔπτατο: πέτομαι — fly; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic (Attic ἐπτόμην): ’flew’
ἔραζε: ἔραζε — to the ground, earthward; adv., ἔρα + directional -ζε
ἔριδος: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contention; fem. gen. sg.
ἔστε: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 pl. (indic. or imper.): ’you are, be’
ἔται: ἔτης — kinsman, clansman (not ἔτος ’year’); masc. nom. pl.
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἕλκ: ἕλκω — drag, draw, pull; impf. 3 sg. act., elided (ἕλκ’ = ἕλκε), unaugmented (= εἷλκε): ’drew’
ἕλκε: ἕλκω — drag, pull; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἷλκε): ’was dragging’ · also ἕλκος — wound, sore; neut. acc. pl. ἕλκεα, elided (ἕλκε’ = ἕλκεα), uncontracted (= Attic ἕλκη): ’wounds’
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’)
ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’) · also ἤ = ἦ, interrogative particle opening a direct question: ’can it be that …?’ (ἤ ῥ’ ἔτι που σχήσουσι … ’can they still, I wonder, hold back …?’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or adverb of degree (ἤ περ ’than’)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤνοπι: Ἤνοψ — Enops, a Trojan, father of Satnius; masc. dat. sg. · also ἤνοψ — gleaming (of bronze; sense uncertain); masc. dat. sg., formulaic epithet of bronze
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἥρην: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. acc. sg. (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰόντες: εἶμι — go, come; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going, coming’
ἱερὸν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; adj., masc. acc. sg. (the neut. has the same spelling) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κνέφας: ’holy (darkness)’
ἴδ: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἴδ’ = ἴδε = εἶδε): ’saw’
ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
ἵκωνται: ἱκνέομαι — come, reach; aor. subj. 3 pl. mid., in a clause with ἄν: ’(until) they reach’
ἵππον: ἵππος — horse; masc. acc. sg., collective: ’horse’
ὀλοφύρεται: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, grieve, feel pity; pres. 3 sg.: ’grieves’
ὀχέων: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. gen. pl.
ὁρμηθείς: ὁρμάω — set in motion, rush; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg., passive in form, active in sense: ’having rushed’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄρουσαν: ὀρούω — rush, leap, spring up; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ὤρουσαν): ’they rushed, leapt’
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’)
ὅδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’this’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ὑπὲρ σέθεν αἴσχε’ ἀκούω ’I hear shameful things about you’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’)
ὑσμίνης: ὑσμίνη — battle, fight; fem. gen. sg.
ὑσμίνῃ: ὑσμίνη — battle, fray; fem. dat. sg.
ὑψηλοῖο: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὑψηλῇ: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; fem. dat. sg.
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, by; postpositive prep. (anastrophe) + gen.: ’under, at the stroke of’ · also postpositive + gen., ’from under, from’ (κυνῶν ὕπο ’from the dogs’) · also postpositive + dat.: ’beneath’ (τῇ ὕπο ’beneath it’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤ: ὤ — oh! interjection of distress, esp. in ὤ μοι ’oh me!’
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
